name: Grilled New York Strip Steak with Baked Potato (Prince & Princess Menu)
brandOrRestaurant: Disney Wonder & Disney Magic · Prince & Princess Dinner Menu
whyItWorks: Grilled-to-order New York strip loin paired with mashed or baked potatoes offers high iron and zero plant roughage.
prepOrOrderInstructions: Order medium-rare with salt only (sauce on the side) and trim the outer strip of edge fat before eating.
watchOuts: Coarse cracked black pepper if not ordered plain
